_comment: Consent wording posted verbatim with every lead. Spec D.2 step 4 (10 Oct 2026, DRAFT for practitioner review, Q8): the required consent names the WhatsApp sender (SortMyCover, a service of Lead Velocity) and the FSP's later contact, and carries the 18+ statement. The ad-measurement consent is a SEPARATE optional pair, neither option preselected (rule S22). {practice_name}/{fsp_number} are used only when site.json consent_mode is named. The ads text is the CONSENT-OPTIMISE wording of CP-v0.2 as carried in the earlier landing config; confirm it against the contract file.

named.text: I agree that SortMyCover, a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd, may message me on WhatsApp to book and remind me about my call, and may share my details with {practice_name} (FSP {fsp_number}), an adviser from an FSCA-authorised financial services provider, who may contact me by WhatsApp or phone about that call. I am 18 or older. I can opt out at any time by replying STOP.

generic.text: I agree that SortMyCover, a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd, may message me on WhatsApp to book and remind me about my call, and may share my details with an adviser from an FSCA-authorised financial services provider (FSP), who may contact me by WhatsApp or phone about that call. I am 18 or older. I can opt out at any time by replying STOP.

ads.label: I give
ads.text: I give SortMyCover permission to use my details in coded (hashed) form to measure and improve its ads on Facebook and Instagram. It will never use them to send me ads by message. This is optional, and the call does not depend on it.
